card.name: Inside split-up rare words
card.fires_on: Short pieces in the middle of a longer word that is split up, often after Tr, intr, Pre or in a brand name like UPTRAVI or BEIZRAY. It fires on the piece right after the opening letters.

modes.description: Second piece of a word starting Tr or intr, such as trawlers, tragically or intracytoplasmic.

modes.description: Middle piece of a place or personal name or non-English word.
